nodes.label: REQUIREMENT
nodes.tooltipDescription: Ensures Defence T&E is performing as expected and continues to meet Defence’s evolving needs by managing & influencing T&E Defence-wide.

steps.tooltipDescription: Custodian of user experience, assuring technical quality and seamless interaction of individual services.

subSteps.tooltipDescription: Provide T&E Portfolio management with high quality market health data to support Portfolio Development and Delivery
Provides common enablers of T&E, where necessary to deliver the Portfolio’s mission. Accessible to all service providers within the marketplace to meet the needs of the User.

A combination of STEP-Funded T&E Services (Critical MOD owned or retained T&E capabilities, assets and services) and Other T&E Services (UK and international network of services, facilities and ranges available for T&E)
Helps users understand T&E and find and engage the best services for their needs, and MOD to understand market health.

parallelSteps.label: Innovation Services
parallelSteps.tooltipDescription: Innovation Services will possess the capability to perform horizon scans, assessing both peer and adversary capabilities.

nodes.label: Innovation Services
nodes.tooltipDescription: Accelerates and optimises UK T&E R&D investment and de-risks STEP investment.
